constraints.machine: 24 GB shared Mac: at most one computational process per agent at a time, each < 1.5 GB RSS (target < 1 GB); never /tmp (work under step2/engine_a/ip/, step2/engine_b/ip/); kill what you start; no Wolfram
constraints.rules: Euclidean; UV boundary eps only; NO dimensional regularisation in any role (DR literature = statements only); two-point functions at T = infinity (safe, ch08 prop:c8-2pt (ii)); K-route data at finite T; exact results, no fitting (integer relations only on an explicit basis, confirmed at a second precision); no new notation in reported text (code names allowed in json/py only)
constraints.independence: engines A and B are independent in code AND method: each imports only its own code (engine A: engine_a/ and step2/engine_a/; engine B: engine_b/ and step2/engine_b/), generates its own graph census from its own vertex tables, re-derives the lemmas it uses (numerator reduction, localisation constants, Fourier lemma, contact property of the five-line graph), and does not read the other's ip outputs before the comparison phase
constraints.reporting: every reported formula index-free AND in Weinberg-Srednicki two-component form (Def c8-twocomp) AND with the physics-notation supplement of R9; xi in Sigma, eta in Sigma^* are spinor parameters; Q_1, S_1, D_1, K_1, P_1 are one-loop components; test equations are stated with Chapter-8 objects (inner_product_design.tex), the code names below are for json/py only
constraints.cluster_portability: pure Python 3 (numpy, sympy, mpmath, fractions) with optional C kernels for quadrature; deterministic (fixed seeds); one process per job; JSON in, JSON out; command line 'python3 ip_<task>.py --sector <s> --out <file>'; no interactive state; FILE-RELATIVE paths only (os.path.dirname(__file__)), an explicit module bundle per engine, and a gate that every job runs unchanged from a copied directory; known defect: 11 files in step2/engine_a hard-code the absolute path /Users/libotao/Desktop/N4_Costello_BV_2026-10-27/engine_a (d4_cycles, d4_pi_sectors, d4_signs, d4_se_sectors, d4_two_point, d4_y1a, s2_core, s2_ga, s2_trees (2), s2_make_results, s2_verify0d) and must be made file-relative before any IP job is moved to the cluster

code_names.m_K, m_20p, m_zeta, m_20, m_F: one-loop radial constants: Gram = n (1 + m unit) on the trace bilinear, the 20', O_zeta, the 20 (weight 5/2), Fbar_z
code_names.n_K, n_zeta, n_F, n_B, n_E: tree radial norms (n_E: protected weight-3 descendant)
code_names.tau, sigma: {S1(xi),K} = tau O_xi ; {S1(conj xi),O_zeta}(0) = sigma (zeta,conj xi) K(0) (K = trace bilinear); Prop ip-tree (a) is tau sigma = -2
code_names.q, s: Q_1(a) = q unit b and S_1(b)|_{eta = conj xi} = s unit {S1(conj xi),b} on the Konishi pair (a, b) of Prop ip-konishi; gate q + s = -12, radial line s - conj(q) = m_zeta - m_K
code_names.q', s': the same on the 20' pair (Prop ip-twenty); gate q' + s' = 0, radial line s' - conj(q') = m_20 - m_20p
code_names.qbar_n, qbar_n': one-loop classical-type coefficients of Q_1 along xi^{dagger_n} = rho(n) conj(xi) in S_- (x) W^* on O_zeta and on the 20 (reflection lines, Prop ip-reflline)
code_names.kappa_B, c_B', c_K, b_F, b_B, U, V: weight-3 data of Prop ip-weight3: {S1(xi),O_zeta} = kappa_B B_z (|kappa_B| = 1/4), Q_1(O_zeta) = unit (c_B' B_z + c_K Fbar_z), protected descendant b_F Fbar_z + b_B B_z = classical image of rho0(xi) rho0(zeta) on the 20', U and V the O_zeta coefficients of S_1|_{eta = conj xi} on B_z and Fbar_z; (i) U = -conj(kappa_B) n_B/n_zeta, (ii) V = -conj(c_K) unit n_F/n_zeta, (iii) c_K unit = -kappa_B conj(b_B) n_B/(conj(b_F) n_F)

code_names.c_F: translation rescaling of family F: P_1 = c_F unit {S1(P_b),-} on F (engines' frame: c_F = -(1/3 + f_P) on the scalar bilinears, f_P = coefficient of S1(P_b) in hbar F_1^(1)(P_b) in units); frame conversion U = 1 + c_F unit w
code_names.f_S, z: f_S = coefficient of S1(Delta)|_{W_R^perp} in hbar F_1^(1)(Delta) (units); z = coefficient of the whole S1(Delta); f_S = z + offset fixed by the cubic arity-one equation along Delta; prediction f_S = -1/3
code_names.r_x, s_a: rescaling of generator x and the three block numbers of Thm ip-P (ii) (r = s_a - s_b)

conventions_to_fix_in_code.lambda_contraction: hbar d_P((lambda(y),g)(lambda(x),f)) = hbar (rho(d_y) 1/(4 pi^2 |y-x|^2) g, f) x inverse pairing of g (conj prop:RP, ch03 prop:c3-P); gives <O_chi1(x),O_chi2(0)>_tree = 24 hbar dim g (rho(x) chi1, chi2)/(16 pi^4 |x|^6) (checks C12)

conventions_to_fix_in_code.frame: all assembled data in the frame P_1 = 0 reached by the inner direction (route (a), Prop ip-frames): convert generator matrices X -> U^{-1} X U, U = 1 + c_F unit w, and keep G0, G1 equal to the two-point coefficients; equivalently keep the engines' matrices and use (1 - 2 c_F unit w) x two-point coefficients; NEVER multiply the two-point G1 by (1 + 2 c unit w) in the frame P_1 = 0 (checks C15: residual proportional to c K_0)
